title: Voyager 1 Reaches One Light-Day From Earth
paragraphs: Voyager 1 is a small space probe. It is from NASA. It left Earth in 1977.
On 18 November 2026, Voyager 1 reached a new place. It is now one light-day from Earth. Light needs one day to go that far.
The probe is very far away. A radio message takes one day to reach it. NASA got a signal back one day later. Voyager 1 is still sending a simple signal.

questions.q: How long does a radio message need to reach it?
